title: H-D Breakout 117 Chrome (Sport Black)
description: Representing Harley-Davidson's prowess in the Performance Cruiser class, the Harley-Davidson H-D Breakout 117 Chrome (Sport Black) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
